_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. figma.com declares its design-token layer in the marketing site's stylesheets (raw/css-vars.json): theme-invariant --fig-*/--global-* scales under core.* and the :root/:root[data-theme='dark']-switching --fig-theme-* roles emitted under both light.* and dark.* so each scope resolves its own value. Measured roles alias to the declared values where they match. The dark set resolves declarations that no public page painted while captured.

sans.description: figmaSans — every heading, control and body on the marketing site; Arial-metric fallback then SF Pro Display/system-ui.

mono.description: figmaMono — code and numeric styling; Arial-metric fallback then SF Mono/menlo.
